SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.
   D. Say Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Historical Development of Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical Development of Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Development of Agriculture.
   C. Explain Historical Development of Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Historical Development of Agriculture as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6.
   C. Explain Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Early Civilisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Early Civilisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation.

5. Which statement about Peaceful Coexistence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Peaceful Coexistence never happens in Kenya.

   D. Explain Peaceful Coexistence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Developments in Medium of trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Developments in Medium of trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Developments in Medium of trade as rumours only.
   C. Say Developments in Medium of trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Developments in Medium of trade.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

8. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal relationships is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Diversity and interpersonal relationships with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical information never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Historical information as rumours only.
   C. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historical information.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

12. Which statement about Maps and map work is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Maps and map work with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Maps and map work as rumours only.
   C. Say Maps and map work never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and map work.

13. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

14. Which statement about Slavery and Servitude is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
